title: Override refuses tampered receipts and reaches the documented end state

completion.statement: sf_eval.py override is now integrity-preserving: it recomputes the receipt self-hash exactly as verify does before recording anything and refuses a mismatch (exit 1, no write, receipt path and stored/recomputed digests named), so a tampered receipt can never be laundered into a verifying one; and an approved override of a digest-valid failing receipt appends the who/when/why record (plus from_verdict), transitions the verdict to pass with the case results untouched as evidence, and re-hashes, so verify and verify-manifest accept the overridden receipt citing the new digest — the end state receipts.md documents. receipts.md and SKILL.md now state these semantics. Three new OverrideTests cover the tampered-receipt refusal (live receipt and the shipped tampered fixture, each byte-identical afterwards) and the overridden-failing end state through verify-manifest. The full sha is recorded in the board record history for story 36.
evidence: SF_SKIP_NETWORK=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_sf_eval.py (53 tests OK; the 3 new override tests failed pre-fix with exit 0 laundering / no verdict transition)
